name: bidetbud-mobile
description: BidetBud Capacitor shell — iOS and Android wrap the same static map as bidetbud.com.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.cjs
scripts.cap:add: npm run sync:web && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.cjs
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.test:mobile: node scripts/sync-web.cjs && node scripts/test-mobile-smoke.mjs && node --test scripts/test-deep-link.mjs
scripts.lint: node --check scripts/sync-web.cjs && node --check scripts/patch-native.cjs && node --check scripts/prepare-assets.cjs && node --check src/native-bridge.js && node --check src/deep-link.cjs
